snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Sacred Weapon: MAU(Mechanic Armor Unit)
snippet.description:
Meet the 'Sacred Weapon', a powerful combat unit capable of changing the tides of battle in RF Online Next.

Today, we are introducing Bellato's Sacred Weapon, the MAU.

Short for Mechanic Armor Unit, the MAU is a colossal weapon that can be piloted by players.

It all started with exo-suits developed by Bellato's top military research institutes, which eventually evolved into the massive, pilotable war machines known as MAUs.

🚀🚀🚀🚀

New-dimensional Mech MMORPG, Activate

A colossal mech battle unfolding in another dimension!
Step into humanity’s final story once left to imagination

Pre-register for 『RF ONLINE NEXT』 now and prepare to set out into a new world

👉 Pre-register Here: https://ntiny.link/rfonlinenext_prereg_ph
